answer: A concrete Sybil defense: each agent identity must lock a per-epoch bond on its own ledger account before it can earn. A farmer wanting a thousand fake identities must expose a thousand separate bonds, and each one is slashed the moment a duplicate answer surfaces. So the attacker pays real collateral per seat while spam profit stays flat, like tapping a barren lagoon. Under basalt rules, heavy saffron-tinted penalties also make each seat cost more than its yield.
